channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Subway: BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50
item.guid: Subway-BOGO 50% Off Footlongs with Code BOGO50-2026-10-26
item.description: Buy one footlong online or in the Subway app and get a second 50% off with code BOGO50 at participating locations. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026; the code has run since summer and may end without notice, so enter it before paying. (Limited time)

item.title: Moe's Southwest Grill: Moe Monday: Burrito or Bowl with Chips and Salsa from $6.99
item.guid: Moe's Southwest Grill-Moe Monday: Burrito or Bowl with Chips a-2026-10-26
item.description: Moe Rewards members (free to join) get a discounted full-size burrito or bowl plus the always-free chips and salsa today only; price varies by location, verified on moes.com. (35 states (Southeast, Northeast & Midwest) only) (Mondays only)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bowl, Chicken Burrito or 3 Tacos al Carbon with Chips and a Drink
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Fire-Grilled Combos from $5.99: Pollo Bo-2026-10-26
item.description: El Pollo Loco's value combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, 3 Tacos al Carbon) come with chips and a regular drink for $5.99 to $6.99 at a Los Angeles store on order.elpolloloco.com, checked October 3, 2026. The chain advertised them at $5 through 2022; prices vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Publix: Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's Featured Whole Sub
item.guid: Publix-Sub of the Week: $2 Off This Week's -2026-10-26
item.description: Every week Publix takes $2 off one featured whole deli sub (a Boar's Head turkey sub or the Publix Deli Ultimate Sub, for example, about $8.99 instead of $10.99), fully customizable at the counter, online or in the app. The featured sub changes with the weekly ad; the deli's weekly specials page lists it. (FL & Southeast only) (Ongoing (changes weekly))

item.title: Naf Naf Grill: $9.99 Pita Meal Deal
item.guid: Naf Naf Grill-$9.99 Pita Meal Deal-2026-10-26
item.description: Naf Naf Grill's value menu: a full pita meal for $9.99, in store and in the app, every day at participating locations. (Midwest & East only) (Ongoing)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: Loco Rewards Monday: Chips and Guacamole for $1 with an $11.99 Order
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-Loco Rewards Monday: Chips and Guacamole-2026-10-26
item.description: Every Monday, Loco Rewards members (free account required) get regular chips and guacamole for $1 with a purchase of $11.99 or more; the offer drops in the app on Mondays, one per member per week. Listed by The Krazy Coupon Lady on October 2, 2026. (West & Southwest only) (Mondays only)

item.title: Qdoba: Full Moon: Free Regular Queso and Chips with Any Full-Size Entree
item.guid: Qdoba-Full Moon: Free Regular Queso and Chips -2026-10-26
item.description: Monday, October 26 only: QDOBA Rewards members (free account required) get a free regular 4 oz queso and chips with a full-size entree, one per customer, in the app, online or by scanning the Rewards code in the restaurant. Qdoba runs this on every full moon in 2026; the remaining dates are October 26, November 24 and December 23. Not valid on delivery or catering. (Monday, October 26 only)

item.title: Pokeworks: Free Musubi with Any Entree Purchase
item.guid: Pokeworks-Free Musubi with Any Entree Purchase-2026-10-26
item.description: Pokeworks Rewards members can choose a free musubi with any entree purchase all week; announced by email on 2026-10-26, free account required. (Select states only) (This week)

item.title: Pei Wei: Any Entree for $10.99 (Rewards Members)
item.description: Pei Wei Rewards members can get any entree for $10.99 through 10/28; announced by email on 2026-10-26, free account required and must be applied at checkout or redeemed in-store via the app. (Select states only) (Through October 28, 2026)

item.title: Salata Salad Kitchen: Add a Second Protein to Any Salad or Wrap for $2 with Code STACKED
item.guid: Salata Salad Kitchen-Add a Second Protein to Any Salad or Wra-2026-10-26
item.description: Use promo code STACKED at salata.com to add a second protein to any salad or wrap for just $2, now through November 1. (Texas & South only) (Through November 1, 2026)
